dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Role? Clerk at the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Name? Ask me again after my shift.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Take a proficiency test? Declare a tax liability? Apply for an exit permit? Rent a mooring space?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Hurry up! And then hurry up some more!

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You're taking too long! Sorry, can't afford to waste precious time on people like...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: ...Never mind, no time. Next customer, please!
